TASK: Configure `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` and Rust backend code for cross-platform bundling (macOS, Windows, Linux) and Windows MSIX Microsoft Store / direct installer support.
DELIVERABLE: Updated `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` with bundle targets (dmg, app, nsis, msi, appimage, deb) and windows/msix/nsis settings (publisher, copyright, category, appx capabilities/publisher identity placeholders), and any needed conditional `#[cfg(unix)]` / `#[cfg(windows)]` handling in `src-tauri/src/` (e.g. `src-tauri/src/daemon/` if needed) so that code builds cleanly on Unix, Linux, and Windows.
SCOPE: `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json`, `src-tauri/Cargo.toml`, and files in `src-tauri/src/`.
VERIFY: Validate `tauri.conf.json` JSON schema and ensure `cargo check` passes on macOS.
STOP WHEN: `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` has complete bundle configs and macOS cargo check passes.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Create a robust, multi-platform GitHub Actions release workflow for Ferryx in `.github/workflows/release.yml`.
DELIVERABLE: `.github/workflows/release.yml` with:
1. Triggers on tag push (`v*`) and `workflow_dispatch` (with optional draft/prerelease flags).
2. Build matrix across `macos-latest` (macOS arm64 and x86_64 or universal DMG/app), `windows-latest` (Windows x64 NSIS `.exe` installer, `.msi`, and MSIX for Microsoft Store packaging), and `ubuntu-latest` (Linux x64 `.AppImage` and `.deb`).
3. Setup steps for Bun, Rust toolchain, and Linux dependencies (libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev, libappindicator3-dev, librsvg2-dev, patchelf, etc.).
4. UI build (`bun run --cwd ui build` / `bun install`).
5. Packaging and release upload step (e.g. using `softprops/action-gh-release` or Tauri release action) to create a GitHub Release and upload all platform installers (DMG, Windows EXE/MSIX, Linux AppImage/deb) directly so users can download installer files immediately.
6. Separate Windows MSIX build / packaging job or step with manifest and instructions for Microsoft Store submission.
SCOPE: `.github/workflows/release.yml`, `.github/workflows/build-test.yml` (optional CI check), and documentation if needed.
VERIFY: Validate workflow YAML syntax and ensure all step references, actions versions (v4), and paths are correct.
STOP WHEN: `.github/workflows/release.yml` is created and validated.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Update the Ferryx landing page in `site/` to provide direct download links for all supported platforms (macOS, Windows, Linux) and verify downloadability.
DELIVERABLE:
1. Update `site/src/components/Hero.tsx`, `site/src/components/CTA.tsx`, `site/src/components/Navbar.tsx` (and any other relevant site components) to provide direct download links for:
   - macOS (Apple Silicon `.dmg` / Intel `.dmg` / Universal)
   - Windows (Direct `.exe` NSIS installer & MSIX package, with Microsoft Store link placeholder)
   - Linux (`.AppImage` & `.deb`)
2. Point direct download links to the GitHub Release latest asset endpoints (e.g. `https://github.com/Indosaram/ferryx/releases/latest/download/...` or `https://github.com/Indosaram/ferryx/releases/latest`), while also providing clean platform dropdown or platform-aware badges.
3. Ensure `site/` builds cleanly (`bun run --cwd site build`).
SCOPE: `site/src/components/`, `site/src/pages/`.
VERIFY: Run `bun run --cwd site build` and ensure exit code 0.
STOP WHEN: Landing page has verified multi-platform direct download links and site build succeeds.

nodes.prompt:
TASK: Perform comprehensive end-to-end verification of the cross-platform release configuration, GitHub Actions workflow, and landing page download links.
DELIVERABLE:
1. Verify `src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` validity and `cargo check` in `src-tauri`.
2. Verify `.github/workflows/release.yml` YAML syntax and structure.
3. Verify `site` build (`bun run --cwd site build`) and test that landing page links correctly resolve to expected GitHub Releases and direct installer endpoints.
4. Write a comprehensive summary documentation in `docs/CROSS_PLATFORM_RELEASE_GUIDE.md` detailing:
   - GitHub Actions Release trigger instructions (tagging & workflow_dispatch).
   - Windows MSIX Microsoft Store submission step-by-step procedure (signing, Partner Center upload).
   - Direct download URL structure and asset naming conventions.
SCOPE: `docs/CROSS_PLATFORM_RELEASE_GUIDE.md`, test checks across repo.
VERIFY: Run all verification commands and ensure 0 errors.
STOP WHEN: All verifications pass and documentation guide is written.
